decisions.reason: Removing duplicated iOS files does not change Android size-optimization requirements; Android code shrinking and image removal are already represented independently.
Duplicate-file removal is an additional iOS size optimization and does not alter the existing requirement to use iOS Thinning.
Removing duplicate files does not change iOS version support, deprecated API refactoring, or UIWebView replacement.
The iOS duplicate-file cleanup does not change full-application localization coverage or localization behavior.
The duplicate-file cleanup has no effect on the requirement to include an iOS Privacy Manifest.
Removing duplicated iOS files does not alter right-to-left layout support.
An iOS-specific duplicate-file cleanup does not affect Android right-to-left layout support.
An iOS-specific duplicate-file cleanup does not change Android localization coverage or behavior.
Removing duplicated files does not change the requirement to renew certificates and establish valid iOS signing.
The iOS duplicate-file cleanup does not determine whether the Android Youku video remains or is removed; that lifecycle decision is separately stated in message 40.
An iOS-specific duplicate-file cleanup does not change Android API-level, dependency, or deprecated-API modernization requirements.
